description: atfl-server engine node (free-micro-1). The daemon's wake path appends each received tell body to the engine's poll_inbound inbox dir via inbox_append.py (server/murph_relay.py reads raw atfl_inbound envelopes from ATFL_A8S_AGENTS_DIR/atfl-server/inbox/). Non-envelope bodies go to dropped/ for inspection. Install: copy inbox_append.py to /srv/atfl/a8s/atfl-server/, then `a8s define atfl-server /srv/atfl/a8s/atfl-server/definition.json` as the atfl user.
